items: Runes or tablet for Enchant Ruby
rewards: Access to Darkmeyer and the Daeyalt Essence Mine

st.t: Talk to Veliaf in Slepe.
Go into the church and talk to Hameln the Jester about how his friend fell ill.
s: Do you know how he fell ill?

st.t: Go to The Rat & Bat pub south east of the church and speak to Carl.
s: Where do you get your Bloody Bracers from?

st.t: Inspect the barrel south of the Rat & Bat Pub.
Follow Carl without being seen; if he spots you, you start again. Go through the church and hide at its north doors until he has passed.
Hide on the east side of the hollow tree just north of the graves.
When he reaches the town's centre square, hide on the north side of the hollow tree next to the gallows.
When he enters the graveyard, hide on the west side of the hollow tree west of the graveyard.

Kill Kroy in his lab, where the cutscene leaves you. If you've left, go down the stairs in the graveyard south of the church in Slepe. Dodge the potion he sometimes throws to avoid damage and your attack rate being reduced.
s: Continue the Sins of the Father quest.

st.t: Destroy both the Lab tables.
Leave the lab through the southern gate, then return to Veliaf in Slepe.
Go down the trapdoor on the east side of Paterdomus and talk to Veliaf, next to Drezel in the dungeon below.
s: I see. So that's why you want to keep him safe, Veliaf?

st.t: Speak to Ivan Strom south of Fenkenstrain's Castle.
Listen to the meeting.
Speak to Ivan Strom outside the east entrance of Paterdomus.
If you didn't bring a knife, search the nearby backpack for one.
Cut 3 vines from the nearby tree.
Combine the vines together.
Use the long vine on the nearby branch.
Swing on the vine.
Walk to the end of the path and tap its last square to continue the trek.
Kill the nail beasts.
Continue the trek.
If you have no axe, kill the nearby zombie for one.
Chop the nearby dead trees for 3 logs.
Wield your axe, or keep a hammer in your inventory. Use your logs on the broken bridge until all 3 gaps are repaired.
Cross the bridge.
Continue the trek.
Kill the juvinates with the Ivandis Flail. Try to attack the one near Ivan before it can attack him.
Continue the trek.
Finish speaking to Ivan Strom.
Talk to Veliaf at the boat house in the south of Burgh de Rott.
Get into the boat to the Icyene Graveyard.
Finish talking to Veliaf and Safalaan.
Talk with Vanescula Drakan.
Open the mausoleum's door.
Speak to Verdita Sefalatis in the Icyene Graveyard.
Speak to Kael Forshaw in the Icyene Graveyard.
Speak to Radigad Ponfit in the Icyene Graveyard.
Speak to Polmafi Ferdygris in the Icyene Graveyard.
Speak to Ivan Strom in the Icyene Graveyard.
Speak to Veliaf Hurtz in the Icyene Graveyard.
Speak to Vanescula in the Icyene Graveyard.
Go to the Meiyerditch lab. The fastest way is through the mines: take the boat to Meiyerditch and ask a Vyrewatch to send you to the mines.
Mine 15 daeyalt ore (needs 20 Mining) and put it in the cart. If you have no pickaxe, ask one of the miners for a bronze one.
Talk to a Vampyre Juvinate to leave the mine.
Head south-east to the house against the eastern wall with a red and yellow tapestry. Walk through the slashed tapestry and go down the stairs.
Speak to Safalaan at the Lab.
Defeat the Mutated Bloodveld (lvl-123). If you aren't taken to it, go through the door to the deeper labs, south-west of where you met Safalaan.
Finish speaking with Safalaan in the Lab.
Search the bookshelf in the room west of Safalaan in the Lab.
Go show Safalaan the Haemalchemy book 2 you found.
Speak to Vanescula in the Icyene Graveyard. Take the boat south of Burgh de Rott to get there.

Take the boat to Meiyerditch and go down the trapdoor in the northern room of Old Man Ral's house, in south-west Meiyerditch. Give Polmafi a Vyrewatch disguise in the hideout below. If you have none, buy the outfit from Trader Sven just south of the house for 1,950 coins, and don't wear it.
Return to Vanescula in the Icyene Graveyard with the Vyre noble outfit.
Talk to Veliaf outside the church in Slepe.
Wield your Ivandis flail and kill Damien Leucurte (lvl-204). He can poison you. Stomp out any of the fires he spawns.
Talk to Veliaf in Slepe.
Return to Vanescula in the Icyene Graveyard with the Vyre noble outfit.

Wear the Vyre noble outfit. Take the boat to Meiyerditch, talk to a Vyrewatch to be sent to the mines, then talk to a Vampyre Juvinate to get out. In the outfit you won't need to mine anything. Go through the crack in Darkmeyer's wall, just north of the mine exit.
Head to the Arboretum in the middle of Darkmeyer, shown by the tree icon on the map, east of the bank. Speak to the guard, Desmodus Lasiurus, outside it.
Speak to Mordan Nikazsi in the house with a water symbol on the minimap, north-east of the furnace, along Darkmeyer's east wall.
Speak to Maria Gadderanks in the jail north of the Arboretum in Darkmeyer.
Speak to Desmodus Lasiurus outside the Arboretum in Darkmeyer.
Search the shelves in the Arboretum in Darkmeyer. Read the Old Note you get.
Read the Old Note. It gives the gallons of water the tree needs, which differs per player. Each turn of the north valve adds 7 gallons and each turn of the south valve adds 4.

Find your number in this list. The row gives the north valve's setting. Its place in the row gives the south valve's setting: the first number is 0, then 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5. North 0: 0, 4, 8, 12, 16, 20. North 1: 7, 11, 15, 19, 23, 27. North 2: 14, 18, 22, 26, 30, 34. North 3: 21, 25, 29, 33, 37, 41. North 4: 28, 32, 36, 40, 44, 48. North 5: 35, 39, 43, 47, 51, 55.
Set the south valve and the north valve, by the Arboretum's entrance, to those two numbers.
Gather 8 logs from the Blisterwood tree.
Return to Vanescula in the Icyene Graveyard with the 8 Blisterwood logs.
Go speak to Vertida in Old Man Ral's basement with the 8 Blisterwood logs.
Speak to Vertida Sefalatis.
Search the nearby crate for a silver sickle.
Use a ruby on the sickle.
Cast enchant ruby on the sickle.
i: Runes or tablet for Enchant Ruby

st.t: Use a blisterwood log on the enchanted sickle.
Use the flail on the blisterwood sickle.

i: Runes or tablet for Enchant Ruby

st.t: Return to Vanescula in the Icyene Graveyard with the Blisterwood Flail.
Speak to Safalaan north of the Icyene Graveyard.
Speak to Vanescula in the Icyene Graveyard.
Prepare for a challenging fight. Speak to Vanescula again.
If the cutscene doesn't take you into the fight, speak to Veliaf next to Vanescula.

Fight Vanstrom Klause. Protect from Magic. He has various special attacks indicated by what he says: My pets will feast on your corpse: A bloodveld will appear which you need to kill from a distance. Blood will be my strength: An orb appears that heals Vanstrom. Lure Vanstrom onto it. Stare into the darkness: Face away from Vanstrom. Once he hits 0hp, he'll heal to 200 and start summoning lightning bolts. Move off tiles where they appear.
If you're not already in the Myreque hideout, climb down the trapdoor in Old Man Ral's house in south-west Meiyerditch. Speak to Veliaf in the hideout to complete the quest.

i: Anything to range the bloodveld during bossfight
